description: This PHP source file defines the QualificationsMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM project, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items for the Qualifications section in the admin menu, specifically overriding the screen URL for viewing qualifications.

classes.name: QualificationsMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that implements menu configuration for the Qualifications menu in the OrangeHRM admin interface, overriding certain screen URLs.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the qualification menu by overriding the screen URL to replace 'save' with 'view', enabling proper navigation within the menu.
